onCreateCommand: nrfutil toolchain-manager launch -- bash -c 'west topdir >/dev/null 2>&1 || west init -l .' && (grep -qF toolchain-env.sh ~/.bashrc || echo source /opt/toolchain-env.sh >> ~/.bashrc)
postCreateCommand: nrfutil toolchain-manager launch -- bash -c 'west update --narrow -o=--depth=1 && west zephyr-export'
